name: Illusory Haze
source:
On a porch that exists outside time, a lonely spirit waits. When a curious girl stumbles through a mysterious mirage, their worlds collide. Through board games, shared jokes, and quiet afternoons, they forge a connection.

[From [url=https://lavishen.itch.io/illusory-haze]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在时间之外的门廊上，孤独的灵魂等待着。当一个好奇的女孩跌跌撞撞地走进神秘的海市蜃楼时，她们的世界发生了碰撞。通过棋盘游戏、分享笑话和安静的下午，他们建立了联系。

[来自[url=https://lavishen.itch.io/illusory-haze]Itch.io[/url]]
